name: Taiwan Steel Union Co., Ltd
summary: Taiwan Steel Union Co., Ltd operates as a manufacturer and distributor of various non-ferrous metals, including zinc oxide, as well as non-metallic mineral products. Furthermore, the company offers extensive industrial waste management solutions throughout Taiwan, encompassing the disposal, treatment, recycling, and sale of both common and hazardous industrial byproducts. This firm, established in 1984, maintains its headquarters in Changhua County.
